name: Harmanjot Singh
comment: Ordered Chaap Burger and Green Apple Crush Shake. Packaging was top-notch and arrived piping hot. Truly Har Bite Me Kirpa! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

name: Amanpreet Kaur
comment: Best Malai Chaap in town! It melts in the mouth and the cashew cream gravy is phenomenal. Arrived boiling hot in 20 mins! ❤️

name: Rajesh Kumar
comment: Their Aloo Tikki Burger and OREO Crush Shake combo is unbeatable! Pure veg, super clean packing, and live rider tracking on map is amazing.

name: Simran Gill
comment: Pani Puri was super fresh, crispy and the teekha mint water was mouthwatering! 100% genuine street food taste with high hygiene.

name: Jaswinder Singh
comment: Har Bite Me Hai Kirpa! Ordered Paneer Roll and Mango Shake with extra ice cream. Quantity and quality both 10/10.
